whyItMatters: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `tool.uv.index` URL over cleartext.
actions: Use the HTTPS endpoint the registry publishes and keep the hostname in the configuration reviewable. Specifically: fix a `tool.uv.index` URL over cleartext.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pyproject.toml no longer carries a `tool.uv.index` URL over cleartext.
